hero.title: Casa del Caballo Soñador | Boutique Hotel in Chacala, Nayarit

about.subtitle: The Sanctuary
about.title: Life moves slower, and nature sets the pace.
about.p1: Located in the vibrant heart of Chacala, Casa del Caballo Soñador offers an unparalleled experience for those seeking tranquility and connection.
about.p2: Our property has been designed with harmony with nature in mind, using sustainable local materials.

amenities.title: Designed for your comfort
amenities.palapa_desc: Open-air terrace for yoga, meditation, and panoramic Pacific views.
amenities.pool_desc: Central oasis with a waterfall jacuzzi under the palm trees.
amenities.kitchen_desc: Fully equipped shared kitchen for culinary experiences.
amenities.comfort_desc: Hot breakfast, fast Wi-Fi, A/C, and 6 mins from the beach.

1.name: Room 1
1.description: TWIN ROOM (King-Convertible). Meaning "gentle step", Paso Suave is ideal for friends, siblings, or solo travelers sharing a restful escape. This airy space features two single beds, A/C, and Wi-Fi.

2.name: Room 2
2.description: Queen Room. Bright and welcoming, Estrella shines with a cozy charm and natural coastal textures. With a queen size bed, A/C, and Wi-Fi, it’s the perfect place to relax.

3.name: Room 3
3.description: A peaceful retreat bathed in soft tones and gentle light, La Luna invites you to relax under the calming glow of the moon. Offers a queen-size bed, A/C, fast Wi-Fi.

4.name: Room 4
4.description: Matrimonial + Day Bed. Spacious and versatile, perfect for couples, friends, or small families. Natural materials and warm decor create a cozy retreat with A/C.

6.name: Room 6
6.description: KING SUITE. Named after the living wood used throughout the room, Madera Viva offers a quiet and grounded atmosphere with a king-size bed and stone accents.

7.name: El Sueño del Mar Suite
7.description: Deluxe King Suite (Jacuzzi + Ocean View). The crown jewel featuring a king bed, office space, and lounge with TV. Crafted from local wood and stone.

roomsData.cocinaDesc: A private communal space, fully equipped for you to prepare your own dishes or simply enjoy the house's ambiance in total privacy and absolute comfort.
